title: Adobe MCP proposed recipe parameters v1.0
$comment: Plan artifact only. Match parameters to the recipe ID $defs. Defaults are annotations, explicitly materialized then revalidated by normalizeRecipeRequest. Cross-field checks and failure codes: recipe-normalization.md. Dynamic maps have constrained patternProperties and additionalProperties:false.

InputKey.description: Exact input binding key, never a filesystem path. Recipe parameter references must exist in RecipeRequest.inputs. Only auto-prepared pr_clip source selectors may use persisted authorized prepared source bindings defined in recipe-normalization.md.

RoleKey.description: Durable sidecar logical role key, never a display-name selector.

DecimalFrame.description: Unsigned decimal frame; BigInt normalization enforces <=9223372036854775807.

PositiveFrame.description: Positive decimal frame count; BigInt normalization enforces <=9223372036854775807.

UnsignedTicks.description: Premiere tick string; BigInt normalization enforces selected-host bounds.

SignedTicks.description: Signed tick offset; negative zero is rejected semantically.

FrameRate.description: Positive rational. Reduce by gcd; require 1<=num/den<=240 for this recipe profile; preserve 30000/1001 exactly.

PixelCanvas.description: Proposed recipe limits; selected host/format and resource limits additionally apply.

NormalizedRect.description: Document-normalized, top-left origin. Check x+width<=1 and y+height<=1.

PixelRect.description: Orientation-corrected pixels; check against actual source bounds.

TextByRole.description: Exact text by durable role. Empty string clears explicitly. No trimming, translation or shortening.

Variant.description: Unique key; omitted title inherits recipe title, empty title explicitly clears it.

FontPolicy.description: min<=max; only explicitly ordered installed PostScript fallbacks are allowed.

MaskPolicy.description: No implicit provider substitution. none preserves current transparency, not background removal.

Sync.description: source zero maps to reference time by offset ticks. reference defaults to voice/interview or audioInput/multicam. Reject duplicate primary/fallback and excessive residual error.

CaptionSettings.description: Source cues use source-media time, remapped after cuts. Configured style/provider must exist. nativeEditable=false alone does not authorize rendered fallback.

Ducking.description: Native editable gain envelope. Object presence requires music input.

BrollPlacement.description: Half-open timeline frames at sequenceRate, source ticks, speed=1. No overlaps or out-of-range placement.

sourceInputKey.description: Explicit sidecar: exact RecipeRequest.inputs key. Auto-prepared sidecar only: may reference a persisted, authorized prepared source binding; never an arbitrary path. Replacement parameter input keys remain request inputs.

RoleSelector.description: Source-bound durable selector, not live TargetRef. Exactly one match required; names/indexes are not selectors.

fingerprintScope.description: Observed projection is explicitly narrower than a full pixel/content fingerprint.

RoleManifest.description: Sidecar loaded through inputs.roleManifest. ownerSha256 binds exact source. pr_clip source media must be explicit authorized inputs.

roleManifest.description: auto: prepare creates and persists exact source-bound role mappings. roleManifest: load inputs.roleManifest. Neither mode permits first-name/index matching.

ps.product_variants.v1.description: Required inputs: product, template, logo. roleManifest input is required only in explicit roleManifest mode. Auto mode persists exact bindings during prepare. Binding and output coverage checks are defined in recipe-normalization.md.

PhotoAdjustment.description: Native-editable typed adjustments. Check level ordering/curve inputs; no raw ActionJSON.

RetouchStep.description: Separate retouch layer/mask. Clone dimensions match; local provider must be configured and authorized.

ps.photo_composite.v1.description: Required input: photo. New working document creates logical roles from creation receipts; no existing-object role lookup. Mask/background/patch keys additionally require inputs.

roleManifest.description: auto: prepare creates and persists exact source-bound role mappings. roleManifest: load inputs.roleManifest. Neither mode permits first-name/index matching.

ps.social_layout.v1.description: Required inputs: template, subject, logo. roleManifest input is required only in explicit roleManifest mode. Auto mode persists exact bindings during prepare. Preserve exact text and declared font/layout bounds.

SilenceCuts.description: When enabled keepHeadMs+keepTailMs<minimumSilenceMs; never cut protected spoken-word spans.

pr.interview_captioned.v1.description: Required inputs: camera, voice. ducking requires music. broll/caption inputKey references are required if used. Delivery audio targets do not come from the informational audioTargetIsExamplePreset flag.

AngleCut.description: Output-frame [start,end). Angle must be in cameraInputs; no first-camera fallback.

pr.multicam_edit.v1.description: Dynamic required inputs are cameraInputs and audioInput. Duration fits synchronized coverage. Reject overlaps/gaps/bounds; editable-track fallback also requires delivery permission.

effect.description: Semantic effects mapped by qualified adapters, not guessed localized component names.

oneOf.description: Clip-local timeline frames at recipe frameRate. Normalizer enforces property-specific bounds; only the named property is replaced.

RevisionChange.description: Closed semantic changes. Preserve declared array order; unique changeKey required; all roles uniquely resolve from roleManifest.

roleManifest.description: auto: prepare creates and persists exact source-bound role mappings. roleManifest: load inputs.roleManifest. Neither mode permits first-name/index matching.

pr.project_revision.v1.description: Required input: project; roleManifest input is required only in explicit roleManifest mode. Auto mode persists exact bindings during prepare. Replacement input keys must be explicit request inputs. Auto-prepared clip-source identities may use persisted authorized source bindings. frameRate must equal the target sequence rate.

TimelinePlacement.description: Sequence frames; start+duration within selected sequence. No implicit extension.

roleManifest.description: auto: prepare creates and persists exact source-bound role mappings. roleManifest: load inputs.roleManifest. Neither mode permits first-name/index matching.

cross.ps_title_to_premiere.v1.description: Required inputs: titleMaster, project; roleManifest input is required only in explicit roleManifest mode. Auto mode persists exact bindings during prepare. Existing targetClipRole holds animation. No mutation of other source instances; preserveAnimation requires a preserving qualified route.
